game_design_concept.title: Dark Sci-Fi Desert Journey Shooter
game_design_concept.elevator_pitch: A third/first-person shooter set in a hostile alien desert. You are a hero alien making an ~800-metre journey across a dark, eroded wasteland toward a colossal ruined citadel, fighting through escalating soldier and beast encounters, culminating in a boss battle on the fortress summit.
game_design_concept.perspective: Switchable TPS / FPS (V key toggles; both share the same physics capsule and weapon system)
game_design_concept.art_style: Dark sci-fi desert: deep space-indigo sky bleeding into a luminous amber horizon, ochre-to-dark-red eroded alien rock ground, procedural weathered structures (oxidised metal, rust, scorched concrete), alien bone and crystal landmarks, and a dominant low golden-hour sun. ACES filmic tone mapping. PBR materials with HDR image-based lighting (Venice sunset). Custom per-pixel volumetric fog with height falloff, drifting wind banks and sun-forward scattering.
core_mechanics: WASD movement with sprint (Shift), crouch (C or Alt hold), jump with coyote-time forgiveness, and a wall-assisted double-jump
Double-tap a move key to perform a directional dodge slide (with i-frames during the roll/slide)
Aim-down-sights (right-click) with tightened reticle; hipfire with wide sci-fi scanner reticle
Shoot, reload (R), and pick up ammo boxes scattered across the level
TPS: alien hero body visible with Vortex Blaster sci-fi weapon, full foot IK, head-aim tracking and verlet-cloth cape
FPS: rigged arms viewmodel with AK-47, weapon bob and ADS zoom
Enemy soldiers (UE Mannequin 'Liz' rig, AK-47, velocity-driven AI with pathfinding, FSM, weapon aim IK, flinch, ragdoll death)
Enemy beasts (Mixamo mutant, root-motion melee, finite-state machine, attack triggers)
AI Director: proximity-based dormancy system — enemies sleep until the player is within ~90 m, wake in encounter groups, and can be woken reactively by gunfire or hits
Health system (100 HP), red damage vignette on hit, blood splatter decals and animated splash VFX
Bullet decals projected onto level geometry and enemy bodies on impact; impact dust/spark/chip VFX
Player export of the scene to UE format (P key)
game_design_concept.setting_theme: A dark alien desert planet at perpetual golden-hour dusk. The world is defined by a wind blowing from the enemy citadel toward the player: banner flags stream back, the player's cape billows against them, sand scuds across the hardpan. The landscape is eroded alien rock — dark red ground, grey-blue macro rock, bone-white tusks and ribs, glowing cyan-tech accents — all lit by a hot amber low sun. The journey narrative: start at an overlook with the citadel on the horizon as a backlit silhouette, fight through a basin, ruined arches, a canyon, a wreck field with the first beast, ascending switchbacks, the castle gate, and finally the summit boss arena inside the citadel.
game_design_concept.player_experience: Deliberate, atmospheric combat across a hostile alien landscape. Movement is grounded and tactical (slow jog, mild sprint, meaningful crouch and dodge). Each encounter is spatially designed (flat arena bowls, canyon chokes, ramp approaches). The journey has a clear visual destination — the citadel — visible from the very first beat and always ahead. Combat rewards positional awareness: enemies flank, beasts close fast, and ammo pickups are limited.
game_design_concept.target_audience: Players who enjoy atmospheric single-player third-person shooters with deliberate pacing, strong environmental storytelling, and tight combat design. Ages 16+.
game_design_concept.unique_hook: A fully procedurally generated journey level built at runtime from a data-driven spine, paired with an alien hero character carrying a sci-fi weapon (the Vortex Blaster) — the world, terrain, navmesh, prop placement and encounter layout are all synthesised deterministically at load time with no level.glb. The dark-alien aesthetic is achieved entirely through GLSL shader grading (no texture replacements for structure albedo), custom volumetric fog, and HDR IBL.
game_design_concept.narrative_elements: Minimal explicit narrative — the world speaks through environment. The player starts on a high overlook; the citadel is visible from the first frame. Wind blows from the enemy stronghold. The journey is a single unbroken push toward the citadel, through escalating opposition. The boss — the largest beast — holds the summit arena. There are no cutscenes or dialogue.
game_design_concept.technical_scope: Buildless ES module game (no bundler). Three.js r127 + Ammo.js (WASM) physics. Custom entity-component system. Procedural terrain (257² heightfield, runtime navmesh). 20 Meshy sculpted world props (meshopt + WebP). HDR IBL (RGBELoader + SH light probe). Custom volumetric fog (overridden Three.js ShaderChunk). ACES filmic tone mapping. Verlet cloth (cape + wind flags). Foot IK + weapon aim IK + head-aim IK. Ragdoll death. AI Director (proximity dormancy clustering). PostFX (bloom). Three-pathfinding for soldier navigation.

core_gameplay_loop.name: Advance
core_gameplay_loop.description: Move along the journey trail toward the citadel, navigating terrain (sprinting, crouching, jumping, dodging) and taking in the expanding vista.

core_gameplay_loop.name: Encounter
core_gameplay_loop.description: The AI Director wakes the next encounter group as you close in. Soldiers flank from cover; beasts charge head-on. Read the arena layout and find position.

core_gameplay_loop.name: Engage
core_gameplay_loop.description: Shoot, dodge-slide for i-frames, aim down sights for precision, reload behind cover, and manage your 100 HP. Blood decals and VFX confirm every hit.

core_gameplay_loop.name: Clear & Loot
core_gameplay_loop.description: Enemies ragdoll on death, dropping their weapons. Collect ammo boxes to replenish, then survey the next segment of trail ahead.

core_gameplay_loop.name: Advance
core_gameplay_loop.description: Push forward; the citadel grows larger on the horizon. The next encounter group sleeps until you arrive.

style_guide.description: Dark sci-fi desert at perpetual golden-hour dusk. The palette is built around a single constraint: the bright pale ground is the background that dark enemy silhouettes stay legible against. Every other aesthetic decision — the deep-indigo zenith, the warm amber horizon, the deliberately dark structures — serves that one combat-readability rule. The only cool accent is a very limited cyan-tech emissive.
style_guide.material_style: PBR MeshStandardMaterial throughout. Structures use GLSL onBeforeCompile graders that procedurally apply rust runs, scorch blooms, wind-drift sand and sky-reflection fresnel — no texture swaps, one shader program per structure family. Ground is world-space triplanar-sampled (no UVs) with macro albedo normalised and blended over a tuned palette, plus rugged erosion layers (grey-blue alien rock macro + residual normal + flow/ridge/AO + erosion-regime). ACES filmic tone mapping at exposure 0.81. HDR IBL (Venice sunset, 1K) for specular + SH diffuse probe. PCFSoft shadow maps. PostFX bloom pass. Custom volumetric fog with height falloff, noise-drifted banks, sun-forward warming and cold pooled-mist colouring.
style_guide.visual_language: Silhouette-first: the bright pale ground reads enemies as dark shapes. The world is backlit — walking toward the sun, the citadel a molten-edged silhouette. Large-scale geography dominates: dune sea, canyon mouth, ruined arches, a colossal citadel. Props are alien bone (tusks, ribs), alien crystal clusters, sci-fi tech (obelisks, pods, platforms), and ruined organic stone (arches, mesas). Banner flags (verlet cloth) stream in the wind from the citadel. The player's cape billows behind them. Combat VFX: cyan muzzle flash, white bullet impacts, blood spray and decals, red hit vignette.
style_guide.ui_theming: Minimal, sci-fi. The main menu is an unbranded CSS-rendered dusk sky painting (no logo, no title). In-game HUD: a layered CSS sci-fi reticle (segmented rotating scanner ring + corner brackets + dynamic spread ticks; cyan in hipfire, amber on ADS); ammo counter bottom-right; health bar bottom-left; camera-mode indicator top-left. White on black throughout. The loading screen is a dark fade with a white spinner and spaced letter-spacing 'LOADING' text.
style_guide.audio_direction: Sparse, functional. The only confirmed audio asset is the AK-47 gunshot (ak47_shot.wav), played as Three.js PositionalAudio from the weapon. No music or ambient soundtrack is loaded; the world atmosphere is visual and through physics-driven effects (cloth, VFX). Sound design should reinforce the desolate desert tone — distant wind, staccato weapon reports, melee impact thumps.
consistency_rules: Ground must always be the brightest surface in the scene — enemies must be legible silhouettes against it.
Structures must be darker than the ground (albedo luminance ~0.16 vs ground ~0.66).
The only cool emissive accent is tech-cyan (#2fd4e0) — no other hue intrudes on the warm/cool desert palette.
All world elements orient to the sun azimuth (-118°) — the citadel sits on the sun's bearing, backlit.
Wind blows FROM the citadel toward the player — cape, banners, sand and atmospheric effects all agree on this one direction.
Fog must be zero inside 55 m (combat contrast is untouchable); noise banks gate on only beyond 55 m.
Reticle colour switches from cyan (hipfire) to amber (ADS) — no other reticle variant.
All characters use the UE Mannequin skeleton (67 bones, identical names) so animation clips are shared by bone name.
The menu carries no branding: no title, no logo, no engine credit — only the CSS sky world.
mood_references: A lone traveller walking INTO the sunset toward a hostile alien fortress
Bladerunner 2049 colour grade meets Dark Souls world design
Dune desert hostility with alien-bone organic accents
Storm-lit dusk sky, warm key light, cold mist in the basins
